interfaces: MagicSeoClient constructor({credentials:()=>Promise<{username,password}>,fetch?:typeof fetch,baseUrl?:string,onMutation?:(event)=>Promise<void>|void}); default origin https://lk.magicseo.ru. Public methods and exact routes are enumerated in contracts-v2/check.mjs T1 cases.

Reads: listProjects(), catalogItems(), getProject(id), getAutolaunch(id), keywordsV2(id,{offset,limit,from?,to?}), positions(id,{from,to}) with checks_mode=one_per_day, positionsJob(id), balance(), balanceDetailed(), listFolders(), keywordsImportPattern(). Preserve pagination total through an explicit typed envelope where needed and document it in types.ts; list methods used by automation return complete arrays after pagination.

Writes: createProject(body), copyProject(body), updateProject(id,body), startJob(id), stopJob(id), setAutolaunch(id,body), resetAutolaunchError(id), startPositionsJob(id), uploadKeywords(id,csvText), setKeywordsField(id,body), createFolder(body), moveCatalogItem(id,body). Multipart field is file. regions are integer Yandex geo ids.

startPromotion(client,id) enables autolaunch.active and verifies GET active:true. One-off POST /job is the separate startJob method. stopPromotion(client,id) disables autolaunch, DELETEs /job and verifies active:false; only successful DELETE or explicit HTTP 404 no-job is an acknowledgment; an error envelope is a failure. Retry stop at most 3 times then throw StopFailedError {projectId,attempts:3}.

package.json: name bb-plugin-magicseo, type module; @get-bb/plugin-sdk 0.6.104, zod, dev-only react/react-dom/runtime shims, typescript, vitest, jsdom and @testing-library/react; scripts test/typecheck/build. T3 adds bb.server; T4 adds bb.app. tsconfig allows .ts imports, strict noEmit bundler resolution and @/* alias. Use installed public SDK types, not private BB imports. Include @types/node/react/react-dom, clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority and the registry runtime shims used by button/table/input/switch/alert-dialog so T4 needs no dependency or lockfile update.
invariants: Pure lib modules use node: built-ins, type-only SDK imports and relative .ts imports; Node 26 runs their contracts without a transpiler.
SECURITY.md: fake credentials may be used in tests; credential values and JWTs are excluded from files, KV, errors, audit entries and browser responses.
Unwrap result for successful envelopes; retain raw balance objects. HTTP 200 with nonempty error fails; error messages use method/path/status and omit server body.

JWT is process-memory only; concurrent login is single-flight; re-login once on 401; network timeouts of POST create/upload/check/job are surfaced without blind replay. Await one sanitized audit callback per mutation attempt; login is excluded.
Do not expose arbitrary authenticated URL forwarding, payments, balance transfer, access control, administrator operations or project deletion.
out_of_scope: Live cabinet mutation probes; full parity for support/referrals/competitors/help/billing-payment/account management; Env Catalog RPC adapter belongs to T3.

tasks.title: Правила запуска и остановки за 48 часов
tasks.display_title: Правила запуска и остановки за 48 часов
interfaces: planSite({site,concerts,projects,now}):Action[]. CityProject={id,name,domain,region,active}; Action={kind:'create'|'start'|'stop'|'skip',city,region,projectId,reason,nearestStartUtc,name?,keywords?}. Group only exact normalized site domain+resolved region; duplicate matches => skip reason duplicate_city_project.

For ordinary concerts, only status publish plus a nonempty link count. Nearest start strictly after now decides: >48h => create/start; <=48h => stop; once that concert starts, the next future concert decides. Exactly 48h is stop. Unknown city => unmapped_city. A city with sold-out/postponed concert is skip special_event_policy_pending until owner policy exists; no guessed policy.

renderKeywords(templates,{gorod,vGorode}):string[] replaces %город% and %в_городе%, deduplicates in input order. CSV serializer uses a single quoted/escaped UTF-8 column; compare GET keywords/import_pattern before live upload; unrecognized layout => blocked keyword_import_format_unverified rather than an inferred header.

executeActions(actions,{client,site,mode,checkpoint?}):Promise<ActionResult[]>; ActionResult={...Action without keywords,mode,outcome:'planned'|'done'|'blocked'|'alert',detail,at,keywordsCount?}. Missing newProject => blocked new_project_settings_missing. In live mode create once, persist returned id/upload stage with checkpoint, upload keywords then enable promotion; never enable after failed upload. runSite({site,client,fetchConcerts,now,mode,checkpoint?}) fetches the complete source snapshot and cabinet project state then plans/executes.
